overall: The AG found the Boston Compact Steering Committee and its subcommittees are not public bodies under the Open Meeting Law because they are not "within government," so no violation occurred and no remedy was ordered.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Boston Compact Steering Committee does not follow the Open Meeting Law, including posting meeting notice and creating minutes.
allegations.key_passage: Because the Steering Committee does not satisfy all three factors, as outlined above, we find that it is not a public body subject to the Open Meeting Law and did not violate it.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Steering Committee's subcommittees also fail to follow the Open Meeting Law, including notice and minutes requirements.
allegations.key_passage: Based on this analysis, the various subcommittees of the Steering Committee are also not public bodies subject to the law.
